name: Lindy
summary: Build AI agents that automate work across your tools.
description: Lindy lets individuals and teams create AI agents ('AI employees') that connect to their apps and company knowledge to handle email, scheduling, sales follow-ups and other tasks. It differentiates itself with no-code agent building and many integrations. New users get $50 in free credits valid for 7 days with no card required; after that paid plans start at $29.99/month for 3,000 credits.
